{{Tocright}}
'''Excavations''' are activities that give rewards after a set amount of time. Excavations improve the more you do them. To unlock a site for excavation, you must pay the permit fee.

* Excavation sites can be found in {{Caldera Park}}, {{Snowy Shores}}, {{Deeproot Spring}}, {{Fungal Marsh}}, and [[Meteor Valley]].
* The level cap for Excavations is level 15.

== Excavation Sites ==
<tabber>
|-|Caldera Park=
There are two excavation sites in Caldera Park.  

=== Volcanic Ruins (A-Site) ===
This site is located on the hill between the potion shop and the cabins.
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$50,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$10,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 4 to 8
* Duration (base): 10h

=== Magma Temple (B-Site) ===
This site is located between the [[Museum]], {{Volcanic Springs}}, and the volcano.
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$2,000,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$50,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 4 to 10
* Duration (base): 16h

|-|Snowy Mountain=
There is one excavation site on Snowy Mountain. It is located at {{Snowy Shores}}, behind the [[Blacksmith|Blacksmith's shop]]. 

=== Frozen Fortress (C-Site) ===
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$10,000,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$500,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 5 to 12
* Duration (base): 22h

|-|Deeproot Spring=
There is one excavation site in the {{Deeproot Spring}} (grotto) area.  

=== Lost City (D-Site) ===
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$100,000,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$1,000,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 5 to 12
* Duration (base): 28h

|-|Fungal Marsh=
There is one excavation site in the {{Fungal Marsh}} area. To find it, head left from {{Rotwood Swamp}} Town, follow the path around and to the left, and look for purple mushrooms and a big purple/black meteor. 

=== Mysterious Meteor (E-Site) ===
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$1,000,000,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$10,000,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 5 to 12
* Duration (base): 34h

|-|Meteor Valley=
[[File:Excavation F.png|none|300px]]
There is one excavation site in the Meteor Valley. It is located at the upstream end of {{Starfall River}}.

=== Alien Wreckage (F-Site) ===
* Permit Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$10,000,000,000,000'''</span>
* Excavation Cost: <span style="color:lightyellow">'''$1,000,000,000,000'''</span>
* Number of items (base): 5 to 12
* Duration (base): 40h
</tabber>

----
== Excavation Levels ==
Excavations have the following stats:
* Level
* Luck
* Items
* Speed

The Level influences the other three. XP is based on the excavation duration.
